posts.text: Why do people protest against the Trump administration and agencies like ICE?  People like @@Giothink it’s a waste of time. They couldn’t be more wrong.  from the civil rights marches of the 1960s, to the marches of the suffragettes for voting rights, people know that public protests and demonstrations change things.

Tennessee Democrats started demonstrating against the Tennessee legislature’s decision to redraw Tennessee congressional maps to remove the only Black majority congressional district. And people like @Alison 🦅🇺🇸 completely misunderstood the meaning of the demonstration.

Lawmakers in Minnesota voted to keep the names of people who are ineligible to vote on the State’s voter rolls.  This includes voters who are deceased. People like @🇺🇸2guys1coup🇺🇸 are asking why.  Here is a fact check that explains.

Israel has tripled its PR budget in an effort to rebuild its image with international tourists that have stopped visiting the country because of the many international law violations carried out by the Israeli government.  and so, they are inviting conservative influencers like @@Joe Redden | Older Millennialand others who can put their spin on the situation.

A map showing a sea of red says to represent “the silent majority” finally speaking up.  But the reality is different: it’s a map from 40’years ago that’s being used to convince people that the preference of U.S. voters is shifting.

Rep. Max Miller, a Republican from Ohio, has been the subject of very serious allegations.  Rep. Miller vigorously denies the allegations made by his ex wife, and is apparently embroiled in a custody battle.

President Trump‘s economic advisor Kevin Hassett celebrated the fact that credit card usage in the United States is “through the roof“ as a sign that consumer economy is doing well. Unfortunately, consumer use is increasing in the United States because inflation is causing food, gas, utilities, and other goods to cost more.

The Virginia Supreme Court struck down the results of the recent referendum that had approved new congressional district maps The decision was based on procedural grounds regarding how the referendum had been carried out. This deals, a major blow to the Democratic Party in the state of Virginia and its balance in the US Congress.

What does it take to be able to get food assistance programs like EBT or SNAP in America? People like @Amanduhhpanduhhh526 think it’s a pretty sweet deal, but the reality is that most recipients struggle making ends meet, especially with rising inflation.
